notes.title: Inventory & MacOS
notes.content:
I tried publishing a different MacOS build so hopefully that will allow apple users to run it.

Multiplayer changes:

I added a way to drop your items so you can exchange items with your friends!

You can also damage each other now for some fun pvp

Added a way to merge your inventory slot items to prevent multiple stacks of the same item
